text:
Marc (Partnerships): quick sync — we have Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant pilot approvals. need to lock governance & release cadence for the connector bundle and the marketplace co-listing. who owns the final ops checklist?
Anna (PM): I can own the ops checklist. will draft a minimal M1 checklist by EOD tomorrow. main open Q: do we require a private preview before marketplace listing?
Ravi (Eng): tech note: Databricks connector needs a small change to auth flow (token refresh) — estimate 2 dev days. Snowflake side mostly ok but we need a schema migration for delta share meta.
Jess (Integrations): :thumbsup: for private preview — partners asked for a 2-week pilot window to validate perf on larger corp tenants. marketplace listing should be gated on pilot signoff.
Sam (Solutions): we'll need two customer-facing FAQ bits: (1) latency/cost expectations per workload, (2) data residency & access model for private deployments. I can draft those.
Marc (Partnerships): plan: (A) private pilot (2w) -> (B) co-marketing announcement + marketplace listing. timeline target 3 weeks from pilot start if no blockers. Owners: Ops checklist = Anna, Auth changes = Ravi, FAQ + enablement = Sam, Pilot coordination = Jess.
Anna (PM): getting the ops checklist structure now. quick ask — are we including recommended quantization/instance sizing per Vector DB? we should add that to checklist.
Ravi (Eng): yes add sizing recs. I'll run a quick perf sweep for Qdrant + small/med/large payloads and post numbers.
Jess (Integrations): coordinating partner legal & security signoffs today. Snowflake asked for an RPM of how we handle KMS keys w/ private deployment — legal wants a short note.
Sam (Solutions): I can own the KMS note with input from EngSec. Ping me the KMS Qs.
Marc (Partnerships): action items captured. small logistics: can DeployBot post a deploy window for the auth change once Ravi has an ETA?
Ravi (Eng): ETA 2 days, will push PR tomorrow morning. request: please reserve a 1-hour deploy window Wednesday 02:00-03:00 UTC.
DeployBot: scheduled deploy window requested by Ravi (Eng) — pending approvals. Use /deploy approve to confirm.
Anna (PM): noted. I'll attach the checklist to the pilot doc and start the private-preview invite list (customers + internal beta).
Marc (Partnerships): thanks all. next sync Friday 15:00 PT — unless something pops up. :eyes: if anyone needs to move the deploy window shout here.
